_comment: How Home Assistant gets the cards. Since v2 there is no inline Linwood resource: HACS installs the release asset and owns the resource entry.
deploy_automation: Linwood cards: deploy from GitHub (webhook trigger; id kept in HA and in the HA_DEPLOY_WEBHOOK Actions secret, never here)
